# Claude Pro / Max China Guide by ChongGrok

> An independent knowledge base for Claude Pro / Max plans and troubleshooting. ChongGrok's merchant service is limited to personal monthly Pro through assisted iOS in-app purchase. ChongGrok is not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Facts and boundaries

- Published US prices: Pro USD 20 monthly or USD 200 annually, Max 5x USD 100 monthly, Max 20x USD 200 monthly; regional pricing and taxes vary.
- ChongGrok's current service opens a personal monthly Pro subscription on the customer's own account through assisted iOS in-app purchase. It does not include Max, team seats or API credits. Max content explains official plans, not merchant availability.
- No Claude password, email password, verification code or recovery code is requested. Do not send full session tokens.
- A Claude User ID is an account identifier. Whether it is needed depends on the current order; confirm the purpose and account before submitting it. It is not a general Anthropic subscription requirement.
- Payment or iOS in-app purchase does not change supported-region eligibility or identity-verification requirements.
- Failed activation is handled under agreed refund conditions. Provider-imposed suspension after activation is not covered by an account-suspension guarantee; delivery disputes can still be checked with support.
- Membership subscriptions are separate from Anthropic API billing.
- No API credits, ready-made accounts, SMS verification, bulk registration, Team/Enterprise bulk service or regional-bypass instructions.
- Online services are not risk-free; no guaranteed activation, recovery or account outcome is promised.
- Merchant service details checked on 2026-10-28 against https://chonggrok.com/claude. Official plan prices and features remain subject to the provider's current pages.
